text.label: Text: Why Proof Sells
text.value: Why Proof Sells

text.label: Heading: A stranger does not buy what you say. They buy what other pe
text.value: A stranger does not buy what you say. They buy what other people say about you.

text.label: Text: Start with the stranger.
text.value: Start with the stranger.

text.label: Text: Picture somebody who found you last night. They watched a cl
text.value: Picture somebody who found you last night. They watched a clip, liked what you said, and clicked through to your website. They do not know you. They have been burned before by somebody who talked a good game. So before they spend a dollar, they go looking for one thing: has this worked for a person like me? Everything you say about yourself is a sales pitch in their eyes. What your students, clients and readers say is evidence. That is the difference.

text.label: Text: Why you have so little.
text.value: Why you have so little.

text.label: Text: Most coaches, authors and influencers have helped far more p
text.value: Most coaches, authors and influencers have helped far more people than their reviews show. The work was good. The clients were happy. Nobody asked. Or somebody asked once, weeks later, in a group message, and a few people answered. That is not laziness. Asking feels awkward, it is easy to put off, and you are busy doing the actual work. So years of results sit in private messages and thank-you notes where no buyer will ever see them. You did the hard part and never collected the receipt.

text.label: Text: What that costs you.
text.value: What that costs you.

text.label: Text: People need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times
text.value: People need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times before they trust you enough to pay. Proof is what makes each of those times count. A clip from you says you know your subject. A review from a student says it worked for somebody. Without the second one, a follower can watch you for a year, enjoy every minute, and still buy from the person down the feed who has a wall of happy clients. You taught them. Somebody else got paid.

text.label: Text: What a talent agent does.
text.value: What a talent agent does.

text.label: Text: Self-promotion is part of the job now, whatever you do for a
text.value: Self-promotion is part of the job now, whatever you do for a living. You have to show up and be seen. But there is one kind you should never have to do yourself, and that is telling strangers how good you are. That is what a talent agent has always been for. Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. We teach you the self-promotion, we package what you know, and we show you how to sell it with a modern website and sales system. This system is the part where your own students do the bragging for you.

text.label: Text: So we build the asker.
text.value: So we build the asker.

text.label: Text: This system exists to fix that one gap. It is an AI employee
text.value: This system exists to fix that one gap. It is an AI employee whose whole job is to stay in touch with the people you are already helping, find out how it is going, and ask the happy ones to say so in public. It does not get embarrassed. It does not forget. It does not get busy. My team and I set it up around the way your program, your book or your coaching actually runs, and from then on every person gets asked. Not most of them. Every one.

text.label: Text: Why it is system four.
text.value: Why it is system four.

text.label: Text: The order matters. Your website gives people somewhere to la
text.value: The order matters. Your website gives people somewhere to land. The content engine sends them there. Speed to Lead answers them while they still care. This system is what turns a curious visitor into a believer, because by the time they are on your website deciding, the proof is already sitting there. And it gets stronger every month you are in business, because every new client becomes the next review. It is the one part of the Revenue Engine that keeps paying you for work you already did.

text.value: The review goes where it does you the most good: your Google listing first, then the other places people look you up before they buy. Anybody can leave whatever they want, wherever they want. We are not standing in the way of that, and no honest system does.

Heading: It repeats

text.label: Text: Every customer, every time, without anyone a…
text.value: Every student, every client, from now on. This is what everybody who sells what they know should already be doing, and almost nobody does, because it is one more thing to remember. Now it is not.

props.text: The ask goes out while they are still happy.

Not three days later when somebody remembers. The moment a student finishes the program, the message is already gone. Timing is most of this. A person is proudest of what they did on the day they finish, and that is the day they will gladly tell the world about it. A week later they are back in their own life and your request is one more thing in a full inbox. You did not get worse in that week. You just asked late. Your AI employee does not ask late, because it is not waiting on anybody to remember. It is watching for the finish and it moves the same minute.

text.label: Text: Step By Step
text.value: Step By Step

text.label: Heading: Exactly how every client, student and reader gets asked.
text.value: Exactly how every client, student and reader gets asked.

text.label: Text: First, we learn your program.
text.value: First, we learn your program.

text.label: Text: Before anything goes out, my team and I sit down with you an
text.value: Before anything goes out, my team and I sit down with you and walk through how a person moves through what you sell. Where does it start? Where do people usually get stuck? Where do they get their first win? Where does it end? Those are the points that matter, and they are different for a twelve week coaching program than for an e-book somebody reads in a weekend. You tell us once. We build the check-ins around those moments, in your words, so they sound like you.

text.label: Text: Then it watches the calendar.
text.value: Then it watches the calendar.

text.label: Text: From the day somebody enrols or buys, your AI employee knows
text.value: From the day somebody enrols or buys, your AI employee knows where they are. It is following the program dates and the payments, so it knows when a student hits the halfway point or a reader has had time to get through the book. Nobody on your team keeps a list. Nobody sets a reminder. When a person reaches one of the moments you named, the check-in goes out on its own, to that one person, at that point in their own journey.

text.label: Text: The check-in is short.
text.value: The check-in is short.

text.label: Text: It is a quick, friendly question about how things are going,
text.value: It is a quick, friendly question about how things are going, sent as a message on their phone. It takes them a few seconds to answer. It is not a long form and it is not a sales pitch. People answer because it is easy and because it feels like you care how they are doing, which you do. You just never had the hours to ask every single one of them. Now every one of them hears from you.

text.label: Text: If somebody is unhappy.
text.value: If somebody is unhappy.

text.label: Text: You find out the same day, privately, while the program is s
text.value: You find out the same day, privately, while the program is still running. This is the part you will come to value the most. A student who is stuck in the middle of your program is a problem you can fix with one phone call. The same student, ignored until the end, is a refund request or a bad review. Your part here is simple and it is the only part that needs a human. You or somebody on your team picks up the phone.

text.label: Text: If somebody is happy.
text.value: If somebody is happy.

text.label: Text: They get asked right then, while the good feeling is fresh.
text.value: They get asked right then, while the good feeling is fresh. The message hands them the link, so it is one tap and they are on the page writing. No hunting, no signing in to something new. Some will write a few lines. Some will record a short testimonial. Either one is gold. And to be plain about it: anybody can still leave whatever they want, wherever they want. We do not hide the unhappy ones. We just make sure the happy ones are actually asked.

text.label: Text: Readers get asked too.
text.value: Readers get asked too.

text.label: Text: This is not only for a high priced program. The person who b
text.value: This is not only for a high priced program. The person who bought your e-book on your website is a customer, and we know who they are because they bought it from you and not from a platform. They get a check-in once they have had time to read it. A reader who loved the book is asked to say so. That review sits beside the book on your website, and it helps the next visitor decide to buy it.

text.label: Text: What your week looks like.
text.value: What your week looks like.

text.label: Text: You do not send anything. You do not chase anybody. You do n
text.value: You do not send anything. You do not chase anybody. You do not keep a list of who to ask. What you see is a short note when a student needs a call, and new reviews showing up with your name on them. A few minutes on the phone here and there is the whole job on your side. Your AI employee does the rest, day and night, with my team behind it and me on your account, and it does it for every person from now on.

props.text: And then they belong on your own website.

Now the part nobody thinks about. You earned those reviews. Right now they live on a page that also lists other people who teach what you teach, so the proof you worked years for is doing its selling inside somebody else's shopping list. Think about what that means. Somebody hears you on a podcast, likes you, and looks you up. The first thing they are shown is you and a row of other choices. Your own happy students just walked that person into a comparison. Nobody did anything wrong. That is simply how those pages are built. So we keep the reviews there, and we also bring them home.

Your rating sits beside everybody else's, with a map and a list of options. The buyer is comparing. That is what the page is built to make them do. You do not own that page and you do not decide what sits next to your name. It still matters, because it is where a stranger checks whether you are real. It is just not where you want them to make up their mind.

The same reviews, pulled in and kept current, with nobody else on the screen, next to your story, your program and a button that books the call. Nothing to compare against. When a new review comes in, it shows up here without you lifting a finger. The person reading it is one tap from your e-book, one tap from your podcast and one tap from a call with you. This is the page you own, so this is the page where the proof gets to finish its work.

Both, ideally. The profile is how they find you. Your site is where the reviews finish the job. One gets you looked up and trusted by people who have never heard your name. The other is where the person who already likes you reads what your students said, sees no other choices, and books the call.

text.value: Here is what most people miss about this system. It does not run once and stop. Every new client you take on becomes the next person asked. Every new reader becomes the next person asked. So the wall of proof on your website keeps getting taller without you thinking about it. The first sale is the hardest one you will ever make. Each review after that makes the next stranger a little easier to convince.

text.label: Text: What it hands to system five.
text.value: What it hands to system five.

text.label: Text: Every check-in teaches us something about a real person. Who
text.value: Every check-in teaches us something about a real person. Who finished. Who loved it. Who went quiet halfway through. That is exactly what the next system, Database Reactivation, needs to do its job. A student who just told the world how happy they are is the first person who should hear about your next program. A reader who loved the book is the natural buyer for the coaching. That is where the cross-sells and upsells live, and it is the easiest money you will ever make.

text.label: Text: One engine, six parts.

text.label: Text: You could ask for reviews without any of the rest of this. P
text.value: You could ask for reviews without any of the rest of this. People try. It falls apart because the reviews land somewhere you do not own and nothing happens with them afterward. Inside the Revenue Engine, the proof has a home on your website, a job in your content and a next step in system five. That is why we build all six together and connect them. That is the work of a modern day talent agency, and I do not see anybody else offering it this way. If you want to see whether you are a fit, the application is right below.
